About this paper

Original paper instructions

Attempt all questions in Sections I to III, and one question in Section IV. This is an original practice paper. It is not a past HSC examination, and none of its questions are taken from one.

Time

The whole paper allows 3 hours (plus 5 minutes reading time). Practice is not timed, so use the paper's times as a guide to pace.

How practice works

  • Each answer is marked, with feedback, when you submit it for marking.
  • Move between questions in any order, and flag any you want to come back to.
  • Your answers are saved as you go, so you can leave and resume.
